title: Revenue Share Pricing Option
description: Revenue-share pricing. The advertiser pays a fixed decimal commission rate applied to settled commissionable_value attributed to the declared conversion event and event source. Spend is rounded once to the ISO 4217 minor-unit precision of currency after multiplication: spend = round_currency(commissionable_value × commission_rate). This is contingent pricing, not fixed-unit pricing or an auction.

pricing_option_id.description: Unique identifier for this pricing option within the product

pricing_model.description: Percentage commission on settled attributed conversion value

event_type.description: Conversion event whose attributed value may become commissionable (for example purchase or subscribe)

custom_event_name.description: Name of the custom event when event_type is custom. Required for custom events and absent otherwise.

event_source_id.description: Event source whose attribution is authoritative for billing. Must match an event source configured through sync_event_sources.

commission_rate.description: Decimal proportion applied to commissionable_value. For example, 0.04 means 4%.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for commissionable_value and resulting spend

commission_basis_description.description: Human-readable definition of inclusions, exclusions, and return or cancellation treatment used by the billing authority to calculate commissionable_value.
